questions.question: What is a tourist visa?
questions.answer: A tourist visa is an official document that allows a person to travel to another country for tourism purposes. This visa is usually issued for tourist activities such as vacation, travel, cultural events or visits to friends and relatives. A tourist visa is usually valid for a certain period and allows the person to enter and stay in the country during this period. Since each country has different visa policies, the tourist visa application process, required documents and visa durations may vary by country.

questions.question: Do I need a passport to get a tourist visa?
questions.answer: Yes, you need a passport for all visa applications.

questions.question: What is required to apply for a tourist visa?
questions.answer: You must have your passport and not have a travel ban.

questions.question: What is a Schengen visa?
questions.answer: It is a visa obtained to travel to countries that are members of the European Union and Switzerland, Iceland, Norway and Liechtenstein, which are not members of the EU. With a Schengen visa obtained from a single country, you can travel to a total of 29 countries, provided that you first enter the country from which you obtained the visa.

questions.question: How does Prince get a tourist visa for me?
questions.answer: We show your round-trip flight ticket and hotel reservation as confirmed, and we also arrange your travel health insurance. Your intent and motivation letters are prepared professionally and personally by our visa experts. We fill out your application forms. In short, all your document tracking is ours. You only go to the consulate for fingerprint and document submission.

questions.question: How long does it take for Prince to process my travel visa?
questions.answer: A visa expert is assigned to our client within 24 hours after the consultancy contract. The document preparation and appointment tracking process begins. In addition, we provide VIP appointment support in America and Schengen countries.

questions.question: How long does the Schengen Visa process take?
questions.answer: The Schengen visa acquisition process varies according to consulate workload. On average, it takes 2 - 4 months.

questions.question: Does having an invitation positively affect my visa result or shorten the process?
questions.answer: Having an invitation may positively affect your visa result but does not shorten your process.

questions.question: Can I go to other Schengen countries with the Schengen visa I got from one country?
questions.answer: You can enter all Schengen countries, provided that you first enter the country from which you obtained the visa.

questions.question: I am not actively working, will there be a problem with my visa application?
questions.answer: No problem. You can apply if a first-degree relative sponsors you or if you show the required amount of money in your account.

questions.question: Can I get a visa-appointment from a different Schengen country while waiting for my Canada visa result?
How long is the travel health insurance valid?
questions.answer: It is valid for the duration of your travel plan.

questions.question: I am under 18, can I get a visa?
questions.answer: Yes, we can get it if there is a consent letter from the mother and father.

nasilVizeAlirim.title: How to Get a Visa?
nasilVizeAlirim.whatIsVisaDesc1: A visa is an official permit document obtained from consulates or entry points to enter a country. There are various types of visas serving different purposes. For example, different visa types such as work visa, travel visa and education visa vary according to the person's travel purpose.
nasilVizeAlirim.whatIsVisaDesc2: Each country has its own visa policies and requirements. Before applying for a visa, it is important to learn about the visa conditions and required documents of the country to be visited.
nasilVizeAlirim.howToGetVisaDesc1: Before applying for a visa, we recommend that you get professional consultancy services. First, you should determine which type of visa you need. Then, you should collect the correct documents and clearly state your travel purpose. There are many details to be considered in the visa application process.
nasilVizeAlirim.howToGetVisaDesc2: You can contact us for detailed information. Our expert team will guide you in your visa application process and we will complete all steps together.
nasilVizeAlirim.workVisaDesc1: Working abroad is a great opportunity to develop your career and gain new experiences. Work opportunities in different countries can contribute to your professional development and help you learn a new language.
nasilVizeAlirim.workVisaDesc2: Before applying for a visa to work abroad, you should research the work visa conditions of the target country in detail. Getting a good visa consultancy service will facilitate your application process. In addition, a stay of at least one year is recommended for cultural adaptation.
nasilVizeAlirim.travelVisaDesc1: Travel visa is the type of visa required for tourist travel. Many countries apply different visa policies for tourists. While some countries offer visa exemption, some require a visa application in advance.
nasilVizeAlirim.travelVisaDesc2: When applying for a travel visa, you should clearly state your travel purpose and prepare all required documents completely. Documents such as passport validity, travel insurance and accommodation reservations are usually required.

content.intro: In today's world, international travel and immigration processes are becoming increasingly complex. Individuals who want to travel abroad for business, education, tourism, or family reunification often struggle with the complex procedures and documents they encounter during visa applications. Professional visa consulting services are of great importance for people who want to overcome these difficulties in the visa application process and increase their chances of success. This is where we, as Prince, come into play.

mission.title: Our Company's Purpose and Mission
mission.text: Prince is a specialized company that provides professional consulting services to individuals and institutions in international visa applications. Our mission is to ensure that our clients manage their visa application processes in the fastest, most accurate, and most effective way. In this context, we offer customized solutions for each of our clients' needs and work diligently to ensure their applications succeed.

tourist.title: Tourist Visas:
tourist.text: For our clients who want to travel abroad for tourism purposes, we provide comprehensive information about the visa requirements of the country to be applied for, travel health insurance, reservations, and required documents. We manage the application process from start to finish, ensuring our clients receive their visas smoothly.

education.title: Education Visas:
education.text: For students who want to study abroad, we manage the education visa application process in accordance with the requirements of the school and country to be applied for. We review all details, from the correct preparation of documents to school acceptance letters and financial sufficiency documents.

work.title: Work Visas:
work.text: For professionals who want to work abroad, we provide consulting services on the preparation of all required documents in the work visa application process, coordination with employers, and consulate interviews. We ensure that work permits, employment contracts, and other related documents are complete.

family.title: Family Reunion Visas:
family.text: For our clients who want to move family members abroad, we handle family reunion visa applications in detail. We provide services such as preparing documents proving family ties, preparing for consulate interviews, and tracking applications.

documentation.title: Documentation:
documentation.text: We ensure that documentation, the most critical stage of the visa application process, is prepared correctly and completely. We help our clients obtain all the documents they need and provide support for correcting missing or incorrect documents.

forms.title: Application Forms:
forms.text: We guide our clients in the process of filling out visa application forms. Aware that incorrectly or incompletely filled forms can put visa applications at risk, we ensure that forms are completed correctly and completely.

appointment.title: Appointment and Tracking:
appointment.text: We manage the entire process from obtaining consulate and embassy appointments to tracking applications. We continuously monitor processes and intervene when necessary to ensure our clients do not experience any disruptions in their application processes.

appeal.title: Appeal and Re-application:
appeal.text: For our clients whose visa applications have been rejected, we provide support in appeal processes by analyzing the reasons for rejection. In case of re-application, we make necessary corrections to increase the chances of the application being accepted.

alternatives.title: Alternative Solutions:
alternatives.text: We help our clients achieve their goals by offering alternative travel or immigration options after visa rejection.

personalized.title: 4. Personalized Consulting:
personalized.text: Each of our clients has different needs, and therefore the services we offer are personalized. We offer customized solutions according to our clients' goals, travel plans, and personal circumstances. We are with them to manage their visa application processes most efficiently.

team.title: Our Expert Team
team.text: As Prince, we work with an expert and experienced team. Our team has extensive knowledge and experience in international visa applications. Each member has in-depth knowledge of consulate procedures, legal requirements, and international immigration policies. We aim to help our clients succeed in their visa application processes by providing them with the most up-to-date and accurate information.

reliability.title: Reliability:
reliability.text: With years of experience, we provide our clients with the most reliable and effective consulting services. We make transparency and honesty our principle in all processes.

success.title: Success Rate:
success.text: Our high success rate is an indicator of our service quality. We achieve successful results by managing our clients' visa applications to the highest standards.

personal.title: Personalized Service:
personal.text: Every client is special to us, and we offer customized solutions for each of their needs. We design our consulting process according to our clients' personal circumstances and goals.

support.title: Support and Guidance:
support.text: We provide full support to our clients at every stage of applications. We are with them at every step, from preparing all necessary documents to consulate interviews.

content.conclusion: As Prince, we aim to be our clients' most reliable travel companion in international travel and working abroad processes. We simplify the complex structure of visa applications with our experience and expertise and offer our clients a smooth process. We are proud to be here to make every client's life easier and help them achieve their goals. Our clients' satisfaction is the greatest reward of our success.

ingiltere.excerpt: The visa required for those who want to travel to the United Kingdom as tourists is called the "Standard Visitor Visa". This visa is suitable for people who want to visit the UK for purposes such as tourist trips, family or friend visits, business meetings, or short-term education programs.
ingiltere.content:
England is one of the four countries of the United Kingdom (UK) and is located in the west of Europe. It has an important place worldwide with its rich history, culture, and economy. Here is general information about England:

Geography

  • Location: England is located in the southeast of the island of Great Britain and borders Scotland to the north and Wales to the west. It is also surrounded by the Irish Sea, Celtic Sea, North Sea, and English Channel.
  • Capital: London is the capital of both England and the United Kingdom. It is an important center worldwide in terms of finance, culture, and history.
  • Climate: Temperate oceanic climate prevails. Winters are generally cold, summers are mild. It is rainy throughout the year.

History

  • Prehistoric and Ancient Period: Monuments such as Stonehenge show that England has been settled since prehistoric times. During the Roman Empire period, England was known as Britannia.
  • Middle Ages: The Norman conquest of England in 1066 is an important turning point in the country's history.
  • Modern Period: In the 16th and 17th centuries, England played a leading role in maritime and colonialism. The Industrial Revolution also began here in the 18th century.

Culture

  • Language: The official language is English and it is one of the most widely spoken languages worldwide.
  • Art and Literature: World-famous writers such as William Shakespeare, Charles Dickens, and J.K. Rowling are from England. London hosts many art galleries and theaters.
  • Music: Groups such as The Beatles and Rolling Stones emerged from England and have had a great impact on world music.
  • Sports: Football is the most popular sport in England. The Premier League is one of the most prestigious football leagues in the world. Cricket and rugby are also quite popular.

Economy

  • Overview: England has one of the largest economies in the world. London is recognized as an international financial center.
  • Industries: Finance, technology, automotive, aviation, and pharmaceutical industries are among the prominent sectors.
  • Currency: British Pound (GBP).

Government

  • Government: England is governed by a constitutional monarchy and parliamentary democracy. The queen or king is the head of state, but political power is limited.
  • Parliament: Parliament, the legislative body of England, consists of two houses: the House of Commons and the House of Lords.

England continues to be an important country worldwide with its historical heritage, cultural richness, and economic power. Every year, millions of tourists visit England to see London's iconic structures, historical castles, and beautiful rural areas.

ingiltere.generalInfo:
General Information About England

England is the largest and most populous country in the United Kingdom. Its capital is London and it is an important financial, cultural and tourism center worldwide.

Geography and Climate

England is located in the southeast of the island of Great Britain. A temperate oceanic climate prevails and it is rainy throughout the year.

Economy

England has one of the largest economies in the world. London is recognized as an international financial center.
ingiltere.touristVisa:
UK Tourist Visa Application Guide

A Standard Visitor Visa is required for those who want to travel to the UK as tourists.

Required Documents

  • Passport (valid for at least 6 months)
  • Application form
  • Photo
  • Financial documents
  • Accommodation reservation
  • Flight ticket reservation

Application Process

The application is made online and usually results within 15-20 business days.
ingiltere.educationVisa:
UK Education Visa

A Student Visa is required for students who want to study in the UK.

Requirements

  • Acceptance letter (CAS - Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies)
  • Financial sufficiency documents
  • English language proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL, etc.)
  • Health insurance

Process

Education visa applications usually result within 3 weeks.
ingiltere.investorVisa:
UK Investor Visa

An Investor Visa is available for those who want to invest in the UK.

Requirements

  • Minimum £2 million investment
  • Investment plan
  • Financial documents
  • Work experience documents

Advantages

Investor visa holders have the right to live and work in the UK.
ingiltere.otherVisas:
UK Other Visa Types

Various visa types are available for travel to the UK for different purposes.

Visa Types

  • Business Visa
  • Family Visa
  • Transit Visa
  • Work Visa

Detailed Information

Each visa type has different requirements and application processes.
ingiltere.workVisa:
UK Work Visa

A Skilled Worker Visa is required for those who want to work in the UK.

Requirements

  • Job offer (from a sponsor-certified employer)
  • English language proficiency
  • Adequate salary level
  • Professional qualification documents

Process

Work visa applications usually result within 3 weeks.
ingiltere.familyVisa:
UK Family Reunion Visa

A Family Visa is required for those who want to reunite with family members living in the UK.

Requirements

  • Family relationship documents (marriage certificate, birth certificate, etc.)
  • Financial sufficiency documents
  • Housing documents
  • English language proficiency

Process

Family reunion visa applications usually result within 12 weeks.

tirDriverVisa.intro: TIR drivers engaged in international transportation must obtain visas to enter the countries where they work. A TIR driver visa is an authorization required for professional drivers to work legally abroad.

generalInfo.title: General Information about TIR Driver Visa
generalInfo.description: A TIR driver visa is an authorization required for professional drivers to work legally abroad. This visa type is specifically designed for drivers working in the international transportation sector.

typeC.title: Type C Visa (Short Term)
typeC.description: This is a short-term visa type. Generally valid for up to 90 days in Schengen areas, this visa type is used for business travel.

typeD.title: Type D Visa (Long Term)
typeD.description: In some cases, TIR drivers may need a long-term visa. Usually required for transportation work exceeding 90 days.

passport.title: Passport
passport.description: Passport valid for at least 6 months, undamaged.

applicationForm.title: Visa Application Form
applicationForm.description: Filled and signed visa application form.

workCertificate.title: Work Certificate
workCertificate.description: Official documents proving the applicant works as a TIR driver.

invitation.title: Invitation Letter
invitation.description: An invitation letter from a company in the destination country (required for some countries).

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.description: Travel health insurance covering the travel period.

vehicleDocuments.title: Vehicle Documents
vehicleDocuments.description: Documents related to the TIR vehicle and its license.

applicationProcess.title: Application Process
applicationProcess.description: Applications are usually made by the driver's affiliated company, through visa application centers or consulates. Since the process may take several weeks, it is recommended to apply in advance. After the application is approved, the driver gains the right to work in specified countries for a specified period.

visaDuration.title: Visa Duration and Renewal
visaDuration.description: Visa duration is generally determined by the transportation job's length. Short-term visas are typically 90 days, while long-term visas can be longer. Renewal is possible if needed when the visa expires, but the renewal process can vary by country and may require a new application.

specialCases.title: Special Cases
specialCases.description: Some countries may offer special visa programs for TIR drivers. For detailed information about these cases, it is recommended to obtain information from consulates or visa consulting services.

note.title: Note
note.description: As Çilek Vize, we provide TIR driver visa services along with fast appointment (VIP) services.

residencePermit.intro: Turkey is an attractive country for many foreigners due to its rich cultural heritage, beautiful geography, and strategic location. Foreigners wishing to stay in Turkey for a long period must obtain a residence permit. This text will provide informative details about residence permits for foreigners in Turkey.

types.title: Types of Residence Permits
types.intro: The main types of residence permits granted to foreigners in Turkey are as follows:

shortTerm.title: Short-Term Residence Permit
shortTerm.whoForDesc: For foreigners wishing to stay in Turkey for purposes such as tourism, business meetings, conferences, research, courses, education, Turkish language courses, investment, and real estate ownership.
shortTerm.durationDesc: Can be granted for up to 1 year and is renewable based on conditions.
shortTerm.documentsDesc: Passport, application form, biometric photograph, health insurance, documents showing financial status, and accommodation documents (rental contract or hotel reservation).

family.title: Family Residence Permit
family.whoForDesc: For spouses, children, and dependent parents of Turkish citizens residing in Turkey or foreigners holding a valid residence permit.
family.durationDesc: Can be granted for up to 2 years initially and is renewable.
family.documentsDesc: Passport, application form, biometric photograph, health insurance, marriage or birth certificate, and documents showing the sponsor's financial status.

student.title: Student Residence Permit
student.whoForDesc: For foreign students wishing to study at universities or educational institutions in Turkey.
student.durationDesc: Granted according to the duration of study and is renewable as long as education continues.
student.documentsDesc: Passport, application form, biometric photograph, student certificate, health insurance, documents showing financial status, and accommodation documents.

longTerm.title: Long-Term Residence Permit
longTerm.whoForDesc: For foreigners who have resided in Turkey continuously for at least 8 years.
longTerm.documentsDesc: Passport, application form, biometric photograph, documents showing financial status, and documents proving the duration of stay in Turkey.

humanitarian.title: Humanitarian Residence Permit
humanitarian.whoForDesc: For foreigners in Turkey due to extraordinary circumstances who cannot benefit from other residence permits.
humanitarian.durationDesc: Determined and renewable according to the nature of the situation.

work.title: Work and Residence Permit
work.whoForDesc: For foreigners who want to work in Turkey.
work.durationDesc: Granted and renewable according to the duration of the employment contract.
work.documentsDesc: Work permit document issued by the employer, passport, application form, and biometric photograph.

application.title: Application
application.description: Applications are made to the General Directorate of Migration Management in Turkey. Applications must be submitted within 30 days of entering Turkey.

prepareDocuments.title: Preparation of Required Documents
prepareDocuments.description: Necessary documents must be collected according to the application type and submitted completely. Documents generally need to be notarized and translated by a sworn translator.

appointment.title: Making an Appointment
appointment.description: After preparing the application documents, an appointment is made with the Migration Management. On the appointment day, documents are submitted, and biometric data is collected.

evaluation.title: Evaluation of the Application
evaluation.description: The Migration Management reviews the application and decides whether to grant the residence permit. The process typically takes between 1 and 3 months.

card.title: Residence Permit Card
card.description: Once the application is approved, the residence permit card is sent to the applicant's address.

renewal.title: Residence Permit Renewal
renewal.description: A renewal application must be made before the current residence permit expires. Renewal applications can be made 60 days before the expiration date of the existing residence permit. The required documents for renewal are similar to those for the initial application and are submitted to the Migration Management.

cancellation.title: Cancellation of Residence Permit
cancellation.description: A residence permit can be canceled under certain circumstances. Examples include activities contrary to the stated purpose of the residence permit, expired and unrenewed permits, and the use of forged documents.

conclusion.title: Conclusion
conclusion.description: For foreigners wishing to obtain a residence permit in Turkey, the process proceeds smoothly with proper document preparation and timely application. Obtaining a residence permit is a legal requirement for those wishing to stay in Turkey long-term, and attention to all steps of the process is crucial. Seeking professional consultation in this matter can increase the success rate of the application.

note.description: As Çilek Vize, we provide consultancy services to foreign nationals for obtaining residence permits in Turkey. For detailed information, individuals are advised to contact their residence permit specialist.

featured.title: Things to Consider When Getting a Visa

vize-alirken-dikkat-edilmesi-gerekenler.title: Things to Consider When Getting a Visa
vize-alirken-dikkat-edilmesi-gerekenler.content:
There are important points to consider when applying for a visa. In this article, we will discuss the problems you may encounter in the visa application process and their solutions.

Pre-Application Preparation

It is very important to prepare all necessary documents before applying for a visa. Applications made with missing documents are usually rejected.

Accuracy of Documents

All your documents must be current and accurate. Details such as having sufficient passport validity and current photos play a critical role in the acceptance of your application.

Application Process

You need to be careful during the application process and complete all steps completely. Check your information carefully when filling out online application forms.

yurtdisinda-calismanin-avantajlari-ve-de.title: Advantages and Disadvantages of Working Abroad
yurtdisinda-calismanin-avantajlari-ve-de.content:
Working abroad can be a dream for many people. In this article, we will examine the advantages and disadvantages of working abroad.

Advantages

One of the biggest advantages of working abroad is the opportunity to experience different cultures. It also usually offers higher salaries and career development opportunities.

Disadvantages

However, working abroad also has some disadvantages. Being away from family and friends, language barriers and cultural adaptation problems are some of them.

kariyerinizi-uluslararasilastirmanin-yol.title: Ways to Internationalize Your Career
kariyerinizi-uluslararasilastirmanin-yol.content:
There are many ways to develop your career at an international level. In this article, we will examine these ways in detail.

Learning Languages

One of the most important steps for an international career is learning a foreign language. Learning the language of the target country, especially English, provides great advantages.

International Experience

Gaining work experience in different countries strengthens your career. This experience contributes to both your personal and professional development.

almanya-da-blue-card-nedir-kimler-basvur.title: Blue Card in Germany: What is it, Who Can Apply and How to Get it?
almanya-da-blue-card-nedir-kimler-basvur.content:
The Germany Blue Card is a residence and work permit designed for highly qualified foreign workers. In this article, you will find detailed information about the Blue Card.

What is Blue Card?

The Blue Card is a residence permit valid throughout the European Union and designed for highly qualified workers. It is an ideal option for qualified professionals who want to work in Germany.

Who Can Apply?

University graduates who have received a job offer in Germany can apply for the Blue Card. In addition, a certain salary threshold must be met.

How to Get it?

To apply for the Blue Card, you must first receive a job offer in Germany. Then you can apply to the consulate with the necessary documents.

hollanda-da-calismak-yasam-kariyer-ve-fi.title: Working in the Netherlands: Life, Career and Opportunities
hollanda-da-calismak-yasam-kariyer-ve-fi.content:
The Netherlands is a country that stands out with its high living standards and job opportunities. In this article, you will find information about working and living in the Netherlands.

Living Standards

The Netherlands is one of the countries with the highest living standards in the world. It is a leading country in health systems, education and infrastructure.

Job Opportunities

There are many job opportunities in the Netherlands, especially in technology, finance and logistics sectors. The headquarters of multinational companies are usually located in Amsterdam and Rotterdam.

hollanda-mutfagi-peynir-stroopwafel-ve-d.title: Dutch Cuisine: Cheese, Stroopwafel and More
hollanda-mutfagi-peynir-stroopwafel-ve-d.content:
Dutch cuisine is known for its world-famous cheeses and delicious desserts. In this article, we will discover the most important flavors of Dutch cuisine.

Cheese

The Netherlands is one of the world's largest cheese producers. Cheeses such as Gouda, Edam and Leiden are world-famous.

Stroopwafel

Stroopwafel is the most famous dessert in the Netherlands. It is made by placing a caramel-like syrup between two thin waffles and is usually served with coffee or tea.

online-vize-danismanligi-nedir.title: What is Online Visa Consulting?
online-vize-danismanligi-nedir.content:
Online visa consulting is a modern service that allows you to manage your visa application process through digital platforms.

Advantages

The biggest advantages of online visa consulting are saving time and being able to apply without leaving home. In addition, the entire process can be tracked digitally.

How Does It Work?

The online visa consulting service helps you fill out your application forms, upload your documents and track your application status.
